## Summary of change :pencil2:

If applied this commit will...

fix an issue where the “double-tap to open/collapse” accessibility hint was not consistently read by VoiceOver.
- Moved accessibility configuration from **findOutMoreLabel** to **findOutQuestionButton**
- Removed the conditional logic inside the animation block to ensure correct toggle behavior for accessibility

### Reason for this change:
Accessibility hints are not reliably announced for non-interactive elements such as UILabel. Applying accessibility to the interactive button ensures VoiceOver consistently reads the “double-tap to open/collapse” action.

# **PR Description**

Remove WebView Timeout Initialization in VFUKWebViewController

**Root Cause**

A spike in error code 6401 (webview timeout) was observed on iOS following the 10.81 release. 
After investigation, the cause was revealed to be the introduction of a timeout value passed to `VFUKBaseWebHandle` in `VFUKWebViewController.setupWebView()`

Prior to 10.81, VFUKBaseWebHandle was always initialised without a timeout:
```
// 10.80 - timeout nil, timer never starts
self.webHandling = VFUKBaseWebHandle(owner: self, webView: webView)
```
In 10.81, a timeout from appconfig was introduced:
```
// 10.81 - timeout = 15s, timer now active for all journeys
self.webHandling = VFUKBaseWebHandle(owner: self, webView: webView, timeout: TimeInterval(timeoutValue))
```

## Summary of change :pencil2:

If applied this commit will...

- Remove webview timeout initialization in VFUKWebViewController, reverting to the previous behaviour of no timeout for webview journeys

linked_prs.title:
Merged PR 301822: Prevent chevron button from intercepting tap events on device plan

**Summary**

Fixed an issue where tapping the chevron icon did not trigger in device plan sub item.

**Screenshot of this part**

**![Screenshot 2026-06-08 at 4.19.42 PM.png](blob:https://vfuk-digital.visualstudio.com/7757e1f2-5d07-4642-8ac6-9a75257259ed) **

Disabled chevron button interaction so tap events are handled by the parent view gesture recognizer.

**After**

Tapping either the device plan sub item row or the chevron icon triggers the same action and navigates the user as expected.
